page_title: LEE 4-1 CRY | Leeds v Crystal Palace 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's the end of the match.

90+11' 4 - 1 Anton Stach (Leeds) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.

90+10' The Leeds players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Thomas Bramall. NO PENALTY! Leeds are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
90+9' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Leeds using VAR. Let's see what happens.
90+9' Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Leeds!
90+8' The attendance is 36334.
90+7' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Bramall had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
90+2' 3 - 1 Goal! Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lucas Perri into the bottom left corner.
90+2' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is going to take the penalty!
90+1' Lucas Perri (Leeds) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+1' Lucas Perri (Leeds) jumps into a tackle and Thomas Bramall signals a foul. It's a penalty to Crystal Palace! Let's see who's going to take it.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) is flagged for offside.
89' The statistic for corner kicks – 9:5.
87' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Piroe (Leeds) replacing Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ethan Ampadu will be replaced by Ilia Gruev (Leeds).
86' A dangerous looking corner kick from Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) is cleared to safety by the defence.

86' Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. Crystal Palace force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' That will be all from Yeremy Pino who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joel Drakes-Thomas (Crystal Palace).

85' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Crystal Palace force their opponents to concede a corner.
85' Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) attempts to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
84' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
82' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
81' Anton Stach (Leeds) brings his opponent down. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick.
80' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. James Justin (Leeds) replaces Jayden Bogle.
79' What a miskick by Anton Stach (Leeds). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
78' Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Dominic Calvert-Lewin wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
77' Substitution. Eddie Nketiah did his best and is replaced by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace).
77' Substitution. Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) in, Jean-Philippe Mateta out.
77' Here is a change. Noah Okafor is going off and Daniel Farke gives the last tactical orders to Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
77' A substitution has been made. Brenden Aaronson is replaced by Ao Tanaka (Leeds).
76' Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Thomas Bramall who sees an offensive foul.

73' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save.
73' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
73' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Crystal Palace.
71' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
71' Total attempts – 17:3. The number of shots on goal at present is 7:1.
70' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) offside.
69' Brenden Aaronson rounds off a good move with a layoff to Joe Rodon (Leeds) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
68' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
66' The game is interrupted now, Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

66' What a great chance for Pascal Struijk (Leeds). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
66' Anton Stach (Leeds) prepares to take a corner kick.
65' Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nathaniel Clyne.
65' Joe Rodon (Leeds) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Leeds get a corner.
63' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Thomas Bramall to decide. The relieved Leeds players can finally celebrate.
62' The goal for Leeds is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
60' 3 - 0 Goal! Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
60' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Anton Stach (Leeds), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
58' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

57' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
55' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
54' Anton Stach (Leeds) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
52' Anton Stach (Leeds) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
52' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Leeds have a corner.
51' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
51' Anton Stach (Leeds) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

50' Anton Stach (Leeds) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Leeds have a corner.
47' Anton Stach (Leeds) tries to play a long through ball into Gabriel Gudmundsson, but the defence breaks the move down.
47' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
46' Oliver Glasner makes a switch. Jefferson Lerma is coming on in place of Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' 2 - 0 GOAL! The long throw finds Jaka Bijol and his headed flick on is easily nodded into the net from close range by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds). It's now 2:0.
45+2' It's like he was asking for a caution. Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card.
45+1' Joe Rodon (Leeds) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
45+1' Anton Stach (Leeds) steps up to send the ball in.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. The linesman points to the corner flag, Leeds are going to take it.
43' Anton Stach (Leeds) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
42' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Bramall and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.
38' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Dean Henderson reacts superbly to deny him.
37' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
36' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Leeds as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
35' Referee Thomas Bramall makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Leeds. Let’s see what happens!
35' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
34' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:2. Shots on target – 0:1.
30' Thomas Bramall blows the whistle, Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) is penalised for a foul. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
29' Anton Stach (Leeds) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
25' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
25' There's an opportunity for Anton Stach (Leeds) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
25' Joe Rodon (Leeds) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Leeds.
19' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Lucas Perri makes a save.

18' Joe Rodon (Leeds) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
18' Anton Stach (Leeds) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
17' Joe Rodon (Leeds) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Leeds are awarded a corner kick.
16' 47:53 – the ratio of ball possession.
14' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
13' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lucas Perri intercepts the ball.
12' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

9' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Bramall interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
8' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds), but the defence gets it clear.
7' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Thomas Bramall had a clear view and blows his whistle.
6' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
3' Noah Okafor (Leeds) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
2' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
